description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named ContextUsageBar that visually represents the usage of context tokens within an application. It includes color configurations, accessibility features, and rendering logic for a customizable progress bar indicating token usage.

classes.name: ContextUsageBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a bar indicating the percentage of context tokens used, with color coding based on usage levels.

methods.name: clampedFractionUsed
methods.description: Calculates the fraction of used tokens, clamped between 0 and 1.

methods.name: percentUsed
methods.description: Returns the percentage of tokens used, or nil if undefined.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides an accessibility label indicating the usage percentage.

methods.name: barBody
methods.description: Builds the visual representation of the usage bar with proper coloring and masking.
